description: This file defines device-specific build configurations and image generation procedures for various devices based on the Layerscape ARMv7 platform. It contains macros and rules for creating firmware images, including kernel, root filesystem, and device tree binaries, tailored for different device variants such as default device, SD boot options, and specific hardware models like the TWR-LS1021A and IoT variants.

methods.name: Device/Default
methods.description: Defines the default device profile including images, firmware, kernel configuration, and build steps.

methods.name: Device/fsl-sdboot
methods.description: Defines the build rules and images for devices booting from SD card.

methods.name: Device/fsl_ls1021a-twr
methods.description: Configures build steps and images for the TWR-LS1021A device with specific binary parts and sizes.

methods.name: Device/fsl_ls1021a-twr-sdboot
methods.description: Defines the SD card boot image creation process for the TWR-LS1021A device.

methods.name: Device/fsl_ls1021a-iot-sdboot
methods.description: Defines SD card boot image creation for the IoT variant of the LS1021A device.
